mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening manufacturing output and economic momentum, which supports earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market tightening and upward wage pressure, which reduces profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening residential investment and construction sector demand, which drags on S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST is below its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% combined with a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a dual labor market shock, which amplifies earnings pressure and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0 and PAYEMS falls for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4% and PAYEMS is falling (t-test p > 0.05).
